title: Configuration of the Simulating Machine
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ and $y$ be Boolean strings, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. Given a state $s$ of the simulating machine, an input-head position $P$ on input $y$, two auxiliary tapes $	au_C,	au_O: br	o	ext{Option}(	ext{Bool})$ with head positions $z_C,z_O ont	ext{}\in\bbr$, define a configuration on input $y$ with state $s$, input-head position $P$, the work tapes and head positions of $c$ followed by the tape storing $x$ and the tapes $	au_C,	au_O$ with head positions $	ext{inputPos}(c)-1,z_C,z_O$, respectively, and an empty output tape.
caveat: The definition delegates the resulting configuration construction to an unavailable helper, and the informal meaning of the tape storing $x$ is not supplied.
